subject: merge-sort

composition.story: Why does splitting help sorting? Main array divides into Left run and Right run, then Left A, Left B, Right A, and Right B. Merge singletons into sorted runs. Compare remaining fronts and move the smaller into Main array. Its sorted prefix grows until the array is sorted.

aha.observation: Choosing the smaller remaining front preserves sorted output because every later item in either run is at least its front.
